typstsubject.heading: Write the subject of an exam of the course {{courseName}}
typstsubject.loadingCompiler: Loading the Typst compiler (first time: a few tens of MB)…
typstsubject.compilerFailed: The Typst compiler does not answer.
typstsubject.noPreview: The preview of the PDF to print appears after the first compilation.

issue.noIdentityZone: Missing identity zone ({{role}}): sheets will be matched to students by hand.
issue.badPoints: Question {{question}}: {{points}} point(s). Points must be positive, in quarters of a point.
issue.qcmWithoutAnswer: MCQ {{question}}: no right answer and no grading.
issue.gradedByHand: Question {{question}} ({{kind}}): graded by hand for now.

typstsubject.openFailed: The file could not be opened
typstsubject.createFailed: The exam could not be created

storage.heading: Subject of the exam {{examName}}
storage.lockedBy: {{login}} is editing this subject (lock until {{until}}): read only. Taking over interrupts their editing; their unsaved changes will be lost.
storage.conflict: The subject was saved elsewhere (another tab or teacher). Download your changes if needed, then reload.
storage.noSubject: This exam has no stored Typst subject.
storage.storeDraft: Store the subject kept by this browser
storage.unavailable: Subject storage is not available on this server: the subject is only kept in this browser.
storage.loadFailed: The subject could not be loaded
storage.templateUnchanged: Changing the subject changes neither the template nor the zones of the exam already created.

files.badPath: File name refused (letters, digits, . _ -, known extension, at most 5 folders)

reuse.label: Start from the subject of another exam

print.title: Print the copies — {{examName}}
print.intro: Each copy repeats the template of the exam ({{pages}} pages); each page carries a code that finds it again at scan time.
print.odd: The template has an odd number of pages: print single-sided, otherwise two copies will share a sheet.
print.advice: Print at actual size (no fit to page). A print run already created downloads again with the same codes: do not create a new print run to reprint a few copies.

versions.title: Subject versions
versions.intro: Each version shuffles the questions of sections marked shuffle, the order of QCM choices, and picks a wording variant. Copies of every version will be rebuilt in the layout of version A for grading.
versions.stale: The subject changed since generation: regenerate the versions.
versions.ok: The versions are compatible: their copies can be rebuilt in the layout of version A.
versions.failed: The versions could not be generated

issue.zoneSize: zone {{ question }} (part {{ part }}) does not have the same size as in version A; do not put an answer zone inside a variant of different height
issue.extraZone: zone {{ question }} (part {{ part }}) does not exist in version A
issue.qcmLetters: QCM {{ question }} does not have the same boxes as in version A
issue.identity: identification zone “{{ role }}” differs from version A
issue.pages: the version has {{ pages }} pages instead of {{ expected }}
issue.nothingVaries: nothing varies: add shuffle: true to a section, QCM choices or a #variant
